notes: GMAT Focus median was reported as approximately 665 in coverage; classic median 720 with middle-80% range 680-770. GPA nulled: only a middle-80% GPA range (3.16 to 3.91) was published, no average or median seen. Acceptance rate reported as around 22%. QS 2026 and P&Q 2025-2026 ranks not seen in snippets and nulled. Fuqua's Class of 2025 median base salary fell from $175,000 to $160,000 per P&Q. The official Class of 2027 profile page publishes only middle 80 percent ranges, with no medians or averages: GMAT Range (Middle 80%) 680-770 with no edition label, GRE Verbal/Quant Combined Range 307-328, EA Range 149-158, GPA middle 80 percent 3.16-3.91. The existing GMAC/BusinessBecause medians (Focus 665, classic 720) were not confirmable on Fuqua's own pages this session; GMAC is not a school domain but was not in the mandatory-replace list, so those entries were left untouched rather than verified. No acceptance rate is published officially. Prior tuition figure (81,000, 2025-26 official COA PDF) superseded by the official 2026-27 rate of 83,700.
